## Fix the error

This code should load the package for reading Excel files - but is returning an
error when run. Run it, read the error message, and correct the code.

```{webr}
#| exercise: load-readxl
library(read_excel)
```

::: {.hint exercise="load-readxl"}
::::: {.callout-tip title="Hint"}
Which package provides functions for working with Excel files? `read_excel()` is
a function provided by the package we need, but `library()` needs the name of
the package we installed.
:::::
:::

::: {.solution exercise="load-readxl"}
```r
library(readxl)
```
:::

```{webr}
#| exercise: load-readxl
#| check: true

if (is.character(.result) && "readxl" %in% .result) {
  list(correct = TRUE, message = "Correct - readxl is the package we need.")
}

```
